# Geo Conquest — geography quiz and world map game

> Free geography quiz game for iOS and Android by BigBrain Global. Answer questions on flags, capitals, country shapes and borders, earn gold and XP, and claim real countries on an interactive world map.

Canonical page: https://omrisherman.github.io/

## Learn the world. Own the map.

Most geography apps stop at the quiz. Geo Conquest turns every correct answer into something you keep: gold that buys real countries on a world map you fill in, one border at a time. No ad ever interrupts a round — the only ones in the game are the ones you choose to watch for a bonus.

### Claim the world

Use your rewards to claim countries on an interactive world map and build a growing empire.

### Practice geography

Put your knowledge of flags, capitals, shapes and borders to the test in focused quiz challenges.

### Progress your way

Earn gold and XP, complete achievements and quests, and unlock new ways to customize your profile.

### Compete globally

Track your progress and see how your geography skills stack up on the global and daily leaderboards.

## Quiz modes

Every mode draws on the same world: 195 countries, their flags, capitals, silhouettes and neighbours. Pick the one that matches what you want to get better at.

### Flag Quiz

Name the country from its national flag — the fastest way to start earning gold.

### Shape Quiz

Identify a country from its silhouette alone, with no flag, name or capital to help you.

### Capitals Quiz

Match capital cities to their countries, from the obvious ones to the ones that catch everybody out.

### Borders Quiz

Spot the country that does *not* share a land border with the others. Harder than it sounds.

### Trail Quiz

Hop from country to neighbouring country by name or capital, building a chain across the map.

### Millionaire Quiz

A fifteen-question ladder for a grand gold and XP prize. Costs a ticket to enter — and nerve to finish.

### Nightmare Mode

The hardest questions in the game, with a gold penalty if you fail. Unlocks once you've proven yourself.

### The Gauntlet

The endgame run, unlocked at level 75. Everything the game knows, back to back, for the biggest payout per answer.

## Every correct answer moves your empire forward.

### Answer

Choose a challenge and prove what you know about the countries of the world.

### Earn

Collect gold and XP as you solve questions and complete objectives. Perfect accuracy doubles your XP.

### Claim

Spend your rewards to take countries and expand your territory on the map.

### Conquer

Keep learning, complete your collection and rise through the rankings.

## Geo Conquest FAQ

### What is Geo Conquest?

Geo Conquest is a free geography quiz and strategy game for iOS and Android, made by BigBrain Global. You answer questions about national flags, capital cities, country shapes and land borders to earn gold and XP, then spend that gold to claim real countries on an interactive world map.

### Is Geo Conquest free?

Yes. Geo Conquest is free to download and free to play on both iOS and Android. Every quiz mode, every country and the top of the leaderboard can be reached without spending money. There are optional in-app purchases, including gold packs and the Conqueror Pass subscription.

### Does Geo Conquest have ads?

Ads never interrupt a quiz — there are no interstitials and no banners mid-game. Every ad in Geo Conquest is one you choose to watch, in exchange for something: double gold and XP on your next quiz, a refilled map when you have run out, an extra Millionaire ticket, or a second chance to continue a Millionaire run. Ignore all of them and the full game is still yours — they are there to speed you up, not to get in your way. Ads are served through Google AdMob; see the [privacy policy](https://omrisherman.github.io/privacy.html) for what that means for your data.

### Can I play offline?

Yes. Quiz content is bundled with the app, so the quiz modes work without an internet connection. Sign in once, then keep playing offline. Progress syncs back up when you reconnect.

### What geography topics can I practise?

National flags, capital cities, country silhouettes and land borders. Dedicated modes cover each one, plus a Trail mode that chains neighbouring countries together, a fifteen-question Millionaire ladder, a high-difficulty Nightmare mode and the level 75 Gauntlet.

### How do I claim countries?

Answer quiz questions correctly to earn gold, then open the world map and spend that gold to claim a country. Each claimed country joins your empire and counts towards your share of the world's land.

### How does the leaderboard work?

Players are ranked by XP. There is an all-time leaderboard covering total XP earned, and a daily leaderboard covering XP earned since the daily reset. The player who finishes first on the daily board receives a gold and ticket reward.

### What does the Conqueror Pass do?

The Conqueror Pass is an optional subscription that multiplies the gold and XP you earn, multiplies your daily login rewards and tickets, and unlocks subscriber-only avatars and premium quests. It changes how fast you progress, not what you can reach — every country and the top rank are achievable without it.

### How do I unlock the Capitals, Borders, Trail and Gauntlet modes?

The Capitals Quiz and the Borders Quiz are unlocked by buying their upgrades in the in-game Shop, under Upgrades. The Trail Quiz unlocks at player level 40, and The Gauntlet — the endgame mode — unlocks at level 75.

### Does my progress sync between iPhone and Android?

Yes. Sign in with the same account on either platform and your countries, gold, XP and level carry over.

### Where can I download it?

Use the official [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/il/app/geo-conquest-trivia-game/id6775380741) and [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.geoconquest.app) links. They take you directly to the Geo Conquest listing for your device.

## Your next country is one quiz away.

Download Geo Conquest and turn world knowledge into a map you can call your own.

# Geo Conquest Support & FAQ

Canonical page: https://omrisherman.github.io/support.html

[← Back to Home](https://omrisherman.github.io/)

## General Questions

### Is Geo Conquest free to play?

Yes! Geo Conquest is completely free to download and play, and every core feature is available without paying. The optional Conqueror Pass subscription multiplies the gold and XP you earn and unlocks exclusive avatars and quests.

### Do I need internet to play?

No! Quiz content ships with the app, so all quiz modes work offline. Sign in once with your account, then play anywhere. Your progress syncs back up the next time you have a connection.

### Are there ads?

Never during a quiz — there are no interstitials and no banners interrupting play. Every ad in Geo Conquest is one you opt into, and each one pays you back:
- **Double rewards** — after a quiz, watch one to get x2 gold and x2 XP on your next run.
- **Out of maps** — watch one to refill a map and jump straight back in.
- **Extra ticket** — watch one for a Millionaire ticket instead of paying gold.
- **Second chance** — watch one to continue a Millionaire run after a wrong answer.

Ignore all of them and the full game is still yours. Ads are served through Google AdMob; see the [privacy policy](https://omrisherman.github.io/privacy.html) for what that means for your data.

## Gameplay Questions

### How do I unlock the Capitals Quiz and the Borders Quiz?

Both are shop upgrades. Open the **Shop** tab, go to **Upgrades** and buy the Capitals Quiz or Borders Quiz unlock with gold. Once bought, the mode stays unlocked on your account.

### How do I unlock the Trail Quiz and The Gauntlet?

Those two are level-gated rather than bought. The **Trail Quiz** unlocks at player level 40, and **The Gauntlet** — the endgame mode — unlocks at player level 75.

### What's the best way to earn gold?

Accuracy beats speed. A clean run pays far more than a sloppy one, and a perfect run doubles the XP you take home. On top of that, daily login streaks, quests and the daily leaderboard reward all pay in gold — and the Conqueror Pass multiplies the lot.

### How does the leaderboard work?

Players are ranked by XP. There are two boards: **all-time**, covering the total XP you have ever earned, and **daily**, covering XP earned since the daily reset. Whoever finishes first on the daily board picks up a gold and ticket reward. Both are in the Leaderboard tab.

### Can I play on both iOS and Android?

Yes! Your progress syncs across iOS and Android. Sign in with the same account and your countries, gold, XP and level carry over.

## Economy & Purchases

### What does Conqueror Pass do?

The Conqueror Pass multiplies the gold and XP you earn from quizzes, daily logins and level-ups, multiplies your daily tickets, unlocks subscriber-only avatars and opens premium quests.

### Can I get refunded for purchases?

Refunds are handled by the store you bought from, not by us. Request one through Apple or Google directly — each has its own refund window and policy.

### Is it pay-to-win?

No. You can own every country and reach the top leaderboard rank without spending a thing. The pass changes how fast you get there and adds cosmetics — it does not raise the ceiling.

## Technical Issues

### The app keeps crashing. What should I do?

In order: (1) update to the latest version of Geo Conquest, (2) restart your device, (3) reinstall the app — your progress lives on your account, not the device. If it still crashes, email us with your device model, OS version and what you were doing when it happened.

### I can't log in. Help!

Check that you are using the right email and password. Use **Forgot Password?** on the login screen to get a reset link, and check your spam folder if it does not arrive. If you originally signed up with Apple or Google, use that same button rather than an email and password.

### My progress isn't saving.

Make sure you are signed in rather than playing as a guest, and that the device has had a connection since your last session so offline progress could sync. If something is still missing, email us with your username and roughly when it happened.

### More Help?

Can't find your answer? Email us at: **[bigbrainglob@gmail.com](mailto:bigbrainglob@gmail.com)**

Include: Your username, device, OS version, and description of the issue.
